subject.title: memory flush never triggers when reserveTokensFloor equals contextWindow

question: What runtime/config policy should OpenClaw use when `reserveTokensFloor + memoryFlush.softThresholdTokens` leaves no positive memory-flush threshold for the active context window?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but changing this behavior affects existing operator config semantics and overlaps with adjacent reserve/soft-threshold proposals, so the permanent clamp, warning, validation, or doctor-migration policy needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Clamp effective runtime threshold
options.body: Keep existing config valid and clamp only the derived memory-flush/preflight budget, with focused tests and docs.

options.title: Migrate invalid config
options.body: Use doctor/config validation to rewrite or reject oversized reserve-floor settings before runtime sees them.

options.title: Wait for broader threshold direction
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose one of the broader threshold/default proposals.

recommendation.title: Clamp effective runtime threshold
recommendation.body: Keep existing config valid and clamp only the derived memory-flush/preflight budget, with focused tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: The original feature history, current blame, and recent memory-flush refactors all point to this owner as the best available decision route for budget policy.
